name: Speed Dial
description: A floating action button that fans out related create actions on an arc or a column, staggered, with labels. The + turns into ×. Escape or a press outside closes it; Escape and choosing an action return focus to the button.
intents: floating action button with more actions
add new item menu on mobile
usage: Use for 2–5 create actions in apps with one main 'add' flow, usually bottom-right on mobile. More than 5 actions belongs in a sheet or menu. Pass `actions` ([{ id, label, icon, onClick, disabled }]) and handle choices in each action's `onClick` or in `onAction(id, action, event)`; with no actions it renders nothing. `label` names the button and the group ("Create"). Open state is uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`) or controlled (`open` + `onOpenChange(open, reason)`). The actions are positioned in place around the button, not in a portal: give it room, and keep it out of ancestors with overflow hidden, which clip the fan (put it in a fixed corner of the page). The ref is the + button. From the + button, Up, Right or Home move focus into the actions (the nearest first) and Down, Left or End go to the farthest; if the menu is closed they open it first. Inside, the arrow keys, Home and End move between enabled actions, and Escape closes and returns focus to the + button.

dataProps.description: [{ id, label, icon, onClick, disabled }]. label is required (the visible pill and the button's accessible name); icon is a built-in icon name or a node; onClick(action, event) runs when it is chosen; disabled shows it dimmed and not choosable. Empty by default (the sample four with `demo`).
(id, action, event) => void when an action is chosen; id falls back to the label. The menu then closes and focus returns to the + button.
Controlled open state. Pair with onOpenChange.
Open state on mount when uncontrolled.
Accessible name of the + button and of the action group.
Accessible name of the button while open. Defaults to "Close <label> menu".
The button's icon: a built-in icon name or a node. It turns 135° while open (shows × under reduced motion).
Native disabled on the + button; an open menu closes.
Diameter of the main button: sm 48px, md 58px, lg 68px; the actions are 76% of it. On a phone or a touch screen every action still takes a 44px press. A number sets it in px exactly.
Uses four sample actions when `actions` is not given. For the gallery; off by default.
Other attributes (id, aria-*, data-*, event handlers) go to the + button; className and style go to the root.
The + button: focus it, or measure it.
